transcript: I take a short break But I must study now
spoken_sentences: I take a short break But I must study now
what_is_seen: A young man studying at a desk with an open textbook takes a break to look at his phone, laughing at what he sees. His amusement slowly turns into wide-eyed panic as he realizes how much study time his short break has eaten.

transcript: I study very hard. Look at all my certificates!
what_is_seen: A smiling young woman stands in her room and proudly shows framed certificates to the camera, swapping one for another until she is hugging a whole armful of them.

transcript: I look away for one second. My class is crazy!
spoken_sentences: I look away for one second.
what_is_seen: A teacher writes a quadratic equation on a chalkboard; every time she turns her back, her class erupts into total chaos with students dancing on desks and throwing paper. When she turns around with her coffee mug, everyone is sitting quietly, leaving her baffled.

transcript: I am at home. I take a course online.
what_is_seen: A young woman sits at a table at home with an iced coffee, opens her laptop and calmly works through an online course, sipping and typing.

transcript: Ouch! It's not enough. Ah, yes.
what_is_seen: An animated man sits on a hard window bench and winces, rubbing his sore back. He fetches a yellow cushion, sits on it happily, then comically piles up more and more cushions and gives a thumbs up.

transcript: Today is my graduation. I am so happy!
what_is_seen: A young man in a navy cap and gown with a gold sash stands in a packed stadium at his graduation ceremony. He raises his diploma and cheers as golden confetti rains down.

transcript: I work in a laboratory. I do experiments every day.
what_is_seen: A scientist in a white coat pulls on purple gloves in a laboratory, pipettes blue liquid into rows of tubes, writes notes on a pad, and stores a rack of samples in a lab freezer.

transcript: This library is beautiful. Look at all the books.
what_is_seen: A woman in a mustard coat walks through a grand old library, gazing up in awe at endless shelves and a huge circular tower packed with thousands of books.

transcript: I make my page pretty. I add flowers to it.
what_is_seen: Hands flip through an empty notebook, then use tweezers to arrange a pressed yellow flower and green leaves on the bottom corner of a page, brushing glue to fix the decoration in place.

transcript: Hello. Today I give a presentation to my class. This is my work. I am a little nervous. Thank you for listening.
spoken_sentences: Today I give a presentation to my class.
what_is_seen: A student in a dark red sweater stands in front of her class next to a projector screen with slides, speaking and gesturing at the bullet points while classmates watch.

transcript: We build a wooden shed. It is a big project.
what_is_seen: A group of friends in a field measures and marks planks, drills them together, raises wall frames, and step by step builds a complete wooden shed, celebrating together in front of the finished build.

transcript: There you go.
what_is_seen: An anime girl in overalls kneels in a garden and lifts a seedling out of the soil, revealing its long pale roots. She shakes off the dirt, rinses the roots in a bowl of water, replants the seedling and waters it.

transcript: A ruler makes us a straight line. I have no ruler!
spoken_sentences: A ruler makes us a straight line.
what_is_seen: A student at a classroom desk needs a straight line but has no ruler. He comically tries the edge of a thick book and a calculator and even searches under the desks, until he finally gets a wooden ruler and happily draws a perfect straight line.

transcript: My schedule is very full, but I choose sleep.
spoken_sentences: My schedule is very full, but I choose sleep.
what_is_seen: Four labeled items lie on the floor representing a full schedule: a textbook 'Revise', a laptop 'Work', a gym backpack 'Gym' and a pillow 'Sleep'. A hand hovers over the choices and, one by one, everything disappears until it grabs the pillow - sleep wins.

transcript: This is my school. Come and see it.
what_is_seen: A first-person tour of a school: walking up to the entrance doors at sunrise, through locker-lined hallways, past a classroom of chatting students, the library shelves and the cafeteria line, ending outside on the lawn in front of the school building.

transcript: A normal person looks fast. A scientist looks at everything.
what_is_seen: In a hallway of research posters a student glances at one and walks on, but a scientist in a white lab coat and safety glasses stops, inspects every chart up close, points at curves, scribbles notes on a clipboard and beams with excitement.

transcript: Thank you all for coming. You changed my whole life. For the payoff, here's to the next ten years!
spoken_sentences: For the payoff, here's to the next ten years!
what_is_seen: An animated woman in a green suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a grand hall and gives a heartfelt speech; she gestures, toasts to the next ten years, and the seated audience smiles and applauds.

transcript: I am a student. I study until my coffee is cold.
spoken_sentences: I study until my coffee is cold.
what_is_seen: A young woman in a red beret and glasses studies at a desk stacked with books while her mug of coffee steams; she reads for so long the coffee goes cold, so she comically dumps an ice tray into it, throws the window open and drinks it iced without stopping her studying.

transcript: School has many subjects. Some subjects are very hard.
what_is_seen: A presenter in a cream blazer shows school subjects in quick cuts: equations on a blackboard, a calculator, paint and brush strokes, piano keys and sheet music, a glowing chemistry flask, then she leans on a stack of textbooks and talks to the camera.

transcript: I look at the moon with my telescope. I see something amazing!
spoken_sentences: I look at the moon with my telescope.
what_is_seen: At night a woman in a beanie sets up a telescope on a tripod in her backyard and looks through it at the moon; magnified views show craters and a bright meteor streaking past a crescent moon, and she looks up amazed and tells the camera what she saw.

transcript: My textbook is very long. It is so boring.
what_is_seen: A student sits at a small desk flipping through an enormous, thick textbook, turning page after page with a bored face; the pages never seem to end, and she finally gives up and falls asleep with her head on the book.

transcript: In week one, my university is full. In week five, it is empty.
spoken_sentences: In week one, my university is full.
In week five, it is empty.
what_is_seen: A huge university lecture hall is packed with hundreds of students on laptops and phones in week one; the camera then shows the same auditorium in week five, with row after row of empty seats and only a couple of students left.

transcript: We play a word game. Say a word fast. Barber. Bowling!
what_is_seen: A couple on a couch films themselves playing a word game: a letter B pops up on screen, they think hard, pull faces and race to shout words that start with B, cheering and celebrating after each answer.

transcript: We're so bored. Best afternoon ever!
what_is_seen: A bored couple lies upside down on the sofa, then suddenly jumps up and runs into the sunny garden to play badminton; they chase and dive for the shuttlecock, laughing, until they collapse happily on the grass while their dog runs around them.

transcript: Come on! Keep coming! We made it!
what_is_seen: Three roped mountain climbers in colorful jackets push forward step by step up a snowy ridge, advancing toward an orange flag planted on the summit; they reach the top together and throw their arms up in triumph.

transcript: I ask a question. The card gives me my answer. Really? Again?
spoken_sentences: The card gives me my answer.
what_is_seen: A woman spreads a deck of white cards into a fan on the table, asks a question, and draws one card as her answer; it reads 'You have to wait' and she stares at the camera in annoyed disbelief.

transcript: I said to the left! No! It's perfect here!
what_is_seen: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a couple hanging a picture frame shout at each other about where it should go, pointing fingers forehead to forehead with steam rising, then cool off, laugh and hang the picture together.

transcript: This exam's too hard, I just believe.
spoken_sentences: This exam's too hard, I just believe.
what_is_seen: A young man in a basketball jersey sits at a dim table completely covered in exam papers and worksheets; he leans over the pages, flips through them and gives up, walking away from the table.

transcript: Are you kidding?
what_is_seen: A flower-market worker finds her flowers dumped in a bag on the table and boils over: she grabs her head, hurls the bag down, kicks a bucket across the empty hall and stands over the flowers shaking with clenched fists.

transcript: I arrived this is my hotel. I am so happy to arrive here look at the sea
spoken_sentences: I arrived this is my hotel.
I am so happy to arrive here look at the sea
what_is_seen: A man films himself arriving at a beach resort: he walks up the palm-lined path, cheers at the entrance, unlocks his room door with a key card, tours the room and steps onto the balcony overlooking the turquoise sea.

transcript: Long lens, please. Already here. Light, light. A bit left. You are the best.
what_is_seen: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a photographer shoots a model in a desert canyon while his assistant hands him the long lens, holds up the reflector, passes him a drink and gets a grateful thumbs-up.

transcript: Don't look! Just walk! I told you!
what_is_seen: In a hand-painted animation, an elderly woman and a big bearded man walk backward down an autumn park avenue, arms out for balance, glancing over their shoulders while a duck watches; they finish with a high five.

transcript: (dramatic music) - Here we go! (screaming)
what_is_seen: In a gym two people load big black plates onto a bar and clip them tight; a blonde woman chalks her hands, grips the heavy barbell and deadlifts it to a stand while friends watch, then drops it and celebrates.

transcript: Short on the sides, please. Say no more. Whoa! I look great!
what_is_seen: In a Pixar-style barbershop a client sits with a giant afro and huge beard; the moustached barber trims it all with clippers, comb and scissors, then shows the neat new cut in a hand mirror and the delighted client admires himself.

transcript: Hey! No way! Woohoo! Oh God! That was good!
what_is_seen: In a Pixar-style street court a tall girl in a yellow jersey dribbles between two defenders, drives to the hoop, leaps and dunks the ball, then hangs on the rim as everyone hugs and celebrates.

transcript: Dead. Again. It's alive!
what_is_seen: In a cabin a woman clicks a dead flashlight, unscrews it and tips out the old batteries; she and her friend compare them with fresh ones, load the new batteries in, and the flashlight lights up the table as they cheer.

transcript: Ready? I trust you. I promise. Fall back! You promised me!
what_is_seen: In a 3D-animated hay field a kid pinky-promises a big farmer to catch him; the man does a trust fall, the kid steps aside and he crashes into the hay, sitting up covered in straw and betrayed while the kid grins.

transcript: Yo you again what not me look right there Him it was him
spoken_sentences: Yo you again what not me look right there Him it was him
what_is_seen: In a 3D-animated kitchen a mother finds a flower pot knocked over with soil and paw prints on the floor and angrily points at her teenage son; he denies it and points at the dirt trail, and the paw prints lead both of them to point at the guilty cat under the table.

transcript: I board the plane. I show my ticket and walk to my seat.
spoken_sentences: I show my ticket and walk to my seat.
what_is_seen: POV of a traveler scanning her boarding pass at the airport gate, walking down the glass jet bridge, being greeted by a flight attendant at the plane door, moving along the cabin aisle and settling happily into her seat by the window.

transcript: Wow, that's tight! Aha! Dead center!
what_is_seen: In an anime-style clip, a silver-haired older woman draws a wooden bow, aims the arrow with narrowed eyes and hits the bullseye of a straw target; her big bearded companion celebrates and hands her the next arrow.

transcript: It's coming! Run! Okay, my turn.
what_is_seen: In a cartoon park a big goose steals a family's picnic basket; while her parents cower behind the fence, a small red-haired girl clenches her fists, marches straight at the goose, stares it down and takes the basket back - then her parents lift her up like a champion with a trophy.

transcript: Morning! That's hot.
what_is_seen: A couple in pajamas makes breakfast at sunrise: they fry eggs, butter the toast, drizzle honey on porridge with berries and pour orange juice, then carry it all outside and eat together at a garden table while a rooster struts by.

transcript: Lefty Lucy There she glows
what_is_seen: In a cozy evening living room a man unscrews the dead bulb from a small table lamp, takes a new bulb out of its cardboard box, screws it in, and the lamp glows warmly while his partner watches from the sofa with tea and the cat looks on.

transcript: Ten more minutes! Fininally, here it comes!
what_is_seen: Three cartoon commuters wait impatiently under a bus-stop shelter on a foggy street; an orange double-decker bus finally pulls up, they board, and the bus drives off leaving the stop empty.

transcript: Too hard, look! Now it melts.
what_is_seen: A woman tries to spread butter straight from the fridge and the hard lump tears a hole right through the bread slice, which she shows to the camera outraged; the couple softens the butter by the toaster and she then spreads it smoothly and eats the toast happily.

transcript: Okay, this is my calculator. I am bad at math. I use the calculator for small numbers.
spoken_sentences: I use the calculator for small numbers.
what_is_seen: A man films himself at his kitchen counter presenting his big desk calculator, admits he is bad at math, and demonstratively types 5 + 3 on it to get the answer 8.

transcript: Hello, it's me! No way! Really? Me too. See you soon.
what_is_seen: A 3D-animated woman on a flower-covered rooftop balcony answers her phone and has a lively, joyful call with a friend, gasping, laughing and finally promising to see them soon before hugging the phone.

transcript: Small snack, small light. Ooh! Big one, please! Now burn it. All of it. No! It's still bright!
what_is_seen: In a cartoon basement experiment a coach with a stopwatch feeds a man a tiny snack that makes a bulb glow faintly, then unveils a whole cake which he devours; he must pedal an exercise bike furiously to burn it all off, but the bulb still blazes bright while he collapses.

transcript: There she goes! Best bed ever.
what_is_seen: A couple sets up camp in a pine forest at sunset: they thread the tent poles, raise the tent, hammer in the pegs, inflate a sleeping pad, hang a lantern inside and finally sit in the doorway with steaming mugs.

transcript: My friend cancels our plans tonight! Oh yes! Now I stay home! I am so happy!
spoken_sentences: My friend cancels our plans tonight!
what_is_seen: A man sitting in his car reads a text that says 'Hey, sorry, but I have to cancel our plans tonight', looks briefly shocked, then breaks into a huge grin and fist-pumps because now he can stay home.

transcript: It is so big! King's lived here! Look at that view!
what_is_seen: Two animated tourists cross a lowering drawbridge into a large stone castle on a lake, explore the walled courtyard with knight armor, the fireplace hall and a throne, then look out over the land from the top of a tower.

transcript: That is my letter. This part must go. But it is only news. Not anymore.
what_is_seen: In a hand-drawn animated office, a stern clerk rolls black ink over lines of a man's handwritten letter, cuts a piece off with scissors and drops it in a drawer, then hands him back the letter covered in black bars as he protests it was only news.

transcript: Heavy. That holds.
what_is_seen: Two men close a tall iron gate and wrap a heavy metal chain around its bars several times, pulling it tight to lock the gate shut, then smile and shake hands.

transcript: Whoa, it sinks! Yay! Full circle!
what_is_seen: A woman tries out a new teal swivel chair at a desk: she sits down, sinks into the cushion, leans the backrest far back, spins a full circle with her arms out, then invites the man watching to sit in it too.

transcript: It's dying! Plugged in! Breathe!
what_is_seen: A woman panics dramatically because her phone battery is dying; a man digs a white charger out of a messy drawer, plugs it into the wall socket and connects the phone, and they relax on the sofa giving a thumbs up as it charges.

transcript: One, two, three! I'm going! Round two!
what_is_seen: A couple on a park bench bite sticky caramel candies on sticks and chew with exaggerated effort, their jaws straining as the toffee stretches and glues their teeth, while a squirrel watches from the bench.

transcript: That's snap. Perfect. Mmm, gone. Just melted.
what_is_seen: In a winter cabin a man snaps a chocolate bar into squares with a crisp snap, lets one melt in his mouth, then melts chocolate in a pot and pours it over a bowl of strawberries, which he shares with a woman.

transcript: Hold them like this slowly slowly. Oh, I did it
spoken_sentences: Hold them like this slowly slowly.
what_is_seen: In an animated lantern-lit dumpling restaurant a girl shows a boy how to hold chopsticks in his hand. He practices the grip slowly, finally picks a steamed dumpling from the bamboo basket with them, eats it and both cheer.

transcript: All the way round. It's closed!
what_is_seen: On a beach at dusk a woman drags a stick through the sand all the way around to draw a huge circle. Friends line it with white shells, then the whole group stands along the ring holding shoulders, forming a human circle seen from above.

transcript: Welcome home, my friends. Welcome home, my friends. I belong here now. We are so proud!
what_is_seen: At an animated naturalization ceremony in a bright hall, adults from many countries wearing green sashes receive rolled certificates from an official. A tearful man clutches his scroll, families hug, and everyone waves little flags and cheers.

transcript: There it goes. A bowl!
what_is_seen: In a pottery studio full of vases a woman presses a wet lump of clay onto a spinning wheel. Her muddy hands squeeze and pull the clay upward until it opens into a bowl shape, and she admires the finished piece while a cat watches.

transcript: Alright easy one. What color is the sky blue? Okay, what is 23 plus 87 105 This answer is correct that answer is wrong
spoken_sentences: What color is the sky blue?
Okay, what is 23 plus 87 105 This answer is correct that answer is wrong

transcript: Look! Black! There it goes.
what_is_seen: By a wood stove in a snowy cottage a man picks shiny black lumps of coal from a metal bucket, showing the black dust on his hands to a laughing woman. He loads the coal into the stove with tongs and the fire flares up bright orange.

transcript: Now I'm ready. Do your worst!
what_is_seen: On a frosty bridge a woman swings a long camel coat over her sweater and scarf, slips her arms in, buttons it up, pops the collar and ties the belt. She twirls to show it off while her friend gives a thumbs up, then they walk off.

transcript: Hey, I'm here. It's just so hard. I know. Come here. Thank you. Really.
what_is_seen: In an animated night scene, a young woman cries on brownstone steps; her friend sits down, puts an arm around her, hands her a tissue and a mug of hot cocoa, and she slowly smiles again.

transcript: I want more power. Read this page. But I am powerful. The law says no.
what_is_seen: In an animated marble hall, a politician demands more power; a wigged official lifts a huge old book from a glass case, opens it on the desk and points at the page, and the man reads it and deflates because the law says no.

transcript: One, two, three, out! It's gone.
what_is_seen: A young woman takes a tray of chocolate-chunk cookies out of the oven, holds one up to the camera, dunks it in her hot drink counting "one, two, three, out", then eats cookies at the table with a friend while a cat sleeps on the windowsill.

transcript: Huh, big problem here. Something for me? Now it is perfect!
what_is_seen: A 3D-animated official at a marble office desk refuses to stamp a woman's paper, then rubs his open hand hinting he wants something; she reluctantly hands over a small pouch of gold coins, he pockets it, happily stamps the document and waves her off.

transcript: That's my shirt!
what_is_seen: In a cotton field at golden hour, a young couple picks a fluffy white cotton boll, holds it up to the light and feels how soft it is, then presses it against the man's white t-shirt as he laughs "that's my shirt", and the woman blows the fluff off her palm.

transcript: Ow! My leg is stuck! Hold on, push against me. It's going. Okay, okay. Better.
what_is_seen: During a night run on a stadium track, an animated woman suddenly grabs her calf mid-stride and cries "my leg is stuck"; she sits on the track clutching the muscle while her training partner pushes her foot back to stretch it, and after the pain fades she stands up with a thumbs up.

transcript: I DRIVE THE BUMPER CAR! CRASH! I CRASH INTO MY FRIEND! SO FUN!
what_is_seen: At a night funfair, a man in a bright yellow shirt drives a red bumper car, shouts with joy as he crashes into his friends' bumper cars again and again, and finally cheers into the camera with both arms raised.

transcript: How do I cross the street? First, I look left and right. Then I cross on the white lines. Now, I cross safely.
spoken_sentences: How do I cross the street?
First, I look left and right.
Then I cross on the white lines.
what_is_seen: A man shows how to cross a city street: first he walks while staring at his phone and gets a big red WRONG mark, then he looks left and right and walks on the white crosswalk lines, earning green CORRECT ticks and giving a thumbs up.

transcript: It's just so sad. I know, me too.
what_is_seen: A couple sits on a couch under a blanket watching a sad film; the woman cries and wipes her tears with tissues, the man tears up too, and they end up hugging and smiling through the tears.

transcript: (upbeat music) - Come on, you know you want to. - Okay, I love this.
spoken_sentences: Come on, you know you want to.
what_is_seen: A woman cooking in a retro kitchen starts swaying and twirling her colorful skirt; her partner joins her and the two dance salsa together around the kitchen, ending with a laughing dip.

transcript: Hear this everyone! The new bridge is open!
what_is_seen: In an animated old town, a woman steps onto a stone balcony, unrolls a scroll and loudly declares to the gathered crowd that the new bridge is open; a bell ringer pulls the tower bell and the townspeople cheer and throw their hats in the air.

transcript: I finished school. I finished. This is my degree!
what_is_seen: A young woman in a maroon cap and gown films herself at a huge stadium graduation ceremony, proudly holding up her degree certificate to the camera. She walks along the graduate rows, appears on the jumbotron, and celebrates as confetti rains down.

transcript: It's here! Go go! It's still hot!
what_is_seen: A young couple lounging with their cat jumps up excitedly and races down the hallway when the doorbell rings. A helmeted courier at the rainy doorstep hands them boxes of hot food, and they hurry back to the couch to open the steaming takeout and eat.

transcript: That one, that's it. And it actually works!
what_is_seen: A young woman and man sit at a bright table sketching pencil drawings of a chair, comparing versions and adding measurements. They then cut cardboard, build a small model chair from their sketch, test it with a stone on the seat, and high-five when the design works.

transcript: It's on fire! Hardest thing on earth.
what_is_seen: A gloved jeweler holds a sparkling diamond in tweezers over a green velvet cushion while a red-haired customer gasps in amazement at how it catches the light. transcript: It's ready! Come! To us!
what_is_seen: On a candlelit seaside terrace at dusk, a woman carries a steaming pot to a set table with salad, bread and plates, calling everyone over. Friends gather, serve the stew, pass bread, raise their glasses in a toast, and eat together under string lights.

transcript: Today I get my diploma! I am so proud!
what_is_seen: A young man in a green cap and gown crosses the stage at a graduation ceremony, shakes hands with the officials, and is handed a white rolled diploma tied with a ribbon. He turns to the audience and triumphantly lifts the scroll over his head with both hands, beaming.

transcript: *Door opens* Baralla, I can't stay. But...tonight? I'm sorry. Really. Oh.
what_is_seen: An animated woman waits happily at a candlelit rooftop dinner table with spaghetti and a wrapped gift, waving as her partner arrives. He apologetically tells her he cannot stay and leaves, and she is left crying alone at the table, staring sadly at the untouched dinner and present.

transcript: Oh. That's it?
what_is_seen: A bearded man in a teal raincoat waits excitedly at a street food stand, rubbing his hands, and receives a large tray that turns out to hold only one tiny bite of food. He eats the single morsel in one spoonful, mutters 'that's it?', and stands in the street with the empty tray and a deflated face.

transcript: I don't think so.
what_is_seen: At an outdoor flea market, a young man skeptically examines a gold ring an old woman seller is offering him. He turns it over, squints at it against the light, frowns, says he does not think so, and puts the ring back on the stall table unconvinced.

transcript: (beep) - I can't. - Perfect, go.
what_is_seen: After a timer beep, a woman frantically pulls a sweater over her head, hair standing up with static, while her partner helps her into a scarf, jacket and beanie. transcript: One. Two. Steady. Three drops. That's enough. But better already.
what_is_seen: In an animated old apothecary, a woman squeezes the bulb of a glass dropper, draws up liquid and counts three drops into a wooden spoon. She hands the dose to a red-bearded man wrapped in a blanket, who takes it and immediately looks better.

transcript: We're here! We're here!
what_is_seen: By an open window above a coastal village, a young couple lean over a desk globe, spin it and stop it with a hand. They point at a spot on the little blue planet and grin at each other saying this is where they are, while a cat sleeps on the windowsill.

transcript: (dramatic music) - Oh no! (laughing) You're here!
what_is_seen: A young woman waits at airport arrivals clutching yellow flowers, and when a man pushes his luggage trolley through the doors she covers her mouth and bursts into tears. She runs to him and they hug tightly, both laughing and crying at once.

transcript: And it goes... Sealed!
what_is_seen: By candlelight two women fold a handwritten letter and slide it into a cream paper envelope. They drip red sealing wax on the flap, press a stamp into it and admire the sealed envelope, one giving it a kiss.

transcript: I want that.
what_is_seen: A young woman stuck on a crowded bus with a rusty old handlebar across her lap stares out the window at a cyclist gliding past on a nice bike. She sighs 'I want that', presses her hand against the glass and slumps back with a long envious look.

transcript: Look at my cute eraser. I use the eraser and the eraser becomes a little mountain. So pretty.
spoken_sentences: I use the eraser and the eraser becomes a little mountain.
what_is_seen: A girl excitedly shows a little Mount Fuji eraser in its Japanese box, then rubs out pencil scribbles on lined paper, leaving a pile of grey shavings. As she uses it the blue eraser wears into a snow-capped mountain shape and she holds up the tiny Fuji proudly.

transcript: I do my exercise every day. It is good for me.
spoken_sentences: I do my exercise every day.
what_is_seen: In a sunny garden a woman in workout clothes goes through her routine: jumping jacks, jogging on the spot, toe touches and side stretches. She finishes facing the camera with a big smile and two thumbs up, saying she does her exercise every day.

transcript: (snaps) Oh, nailed it. (laughs) - No one's flying. (upbeat music)
what_is_seen: A young woman leans close to a bathroom mirror and carefully draws a black winged line along her upper eyelid with an eyeliner pen while a friend watches behind her. She finishes the wing, celebrates, and tidies the edge with a cotton swab, getting a thumbs up.

transcript: Don't make me laugh. It's cracking!
what_is_seen: At a cozy pajama night, a woman spreads thick green clay from a bowl over her friend's face with a spatula. The two sit with matching green face masks; the dried masks crack as one starts laughing and warns the other not to make her laugh.

transcript: No, no, no. I can't.
what_is_seen: A young woman on a glass skywalk high above a mountain canyon freezes in terror, gripping the railing with wide eyes and saying she can't go on. transcript: Ready? Go! Okay, you win!
what_is_seen: A young couple stands on a bed in a sunny attic bedroom and starts a pillow fight, swinging and blocking with big white pillows. A pillow bursts, feathers explode everywhere, and they collapse laughing on the feather-covered bed, one conceding that the other wins.

transcript: From the sea! Look! White! It flakes!
what_is_seen: On a beach at sunset, a man grills a whole fish in a wire basket over glowing coals next to a fishing boat, then squeezes lemon over it. A woman lifts a flaky white piece with a fork, tastes it and closes her eyes with delight.

transcript: (upbeat music) - Off you go!
what_is_seen: A couple sits on a wooden dock at a mirror-calm forest lake with a fishing rod out. The rod bends, they reel in and scoop a silvery trout with a landing net, admire it together, then gently release it back into the water and high-five.
